::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this step does

Mortality Step 1 retrieves the authorised mortality REDCap project, keeps the approved death-certificate records and fields, and creates a private analytical source through the selected month-end.

It does not classify deaths as Heart or Stroke.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
1. Choose a completed calendar month.
2. Run mortality Step 1 from the Stata menu or command window.
3. Confirm `Completed successfully`.
4. Check the record summary and the three private output files.
:::

## Before you start

- Confirm the authorised private workspace is available.
- Confirm `$BNR_MORT_REDCAP_TOKEN_FILE` points to the local text file containing the mortality REDCap application programming interface (API) token.
- Select a completed calendar month. Step 1 will not process a future or unfinished month.
- Use the same year and month in every later mortality step.

The token must remain outside Git and must not appear in a DO file, QMD file or log.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files and source"}

| Source | What Step 1 uses or checks |
|---|---|
| Mortality REDCap project at `https://caribdata.org/redcap/api/` | The full project is retrieved temporarily. Stata then keeps the mortality arm and the 48 approved source fields. |
| `$BNR_MORT_REDCAP_TOKEN_FILE` | Local private text file containing the API token. Confirm the path is configured and the file contains the current token. |
| `scripts/stata/config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` | Untracked workstation-specific paths. Confirm the private and log locations are defined. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do` | Main Step 1 controller; run by the menu, dialog or Stata command. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_mort_s1_extract.dlg` | Stata dialog for the year, month and replacement choice. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds the Step 1 command to the BNR Stata menu. |
| `scripts/stata/config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` | Supplies local paths and the token-file location automatically. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

Step 1 writes private files to `$BNR_DATA_RAW/redcap/mortality/yYYYY/mMM/`.

| File | What it contains |
|---|---|
| `bnr_mort_s1_YYYYMM_raw.csv` | Restricted private mortality source after the temporary full-project extract has been filtered. |
| `bnr_mort_s1_YYYYMM.dta` | Private analytical source with approved fields, derived dates, cleaned cause text and automated-check flags. Step 2 reads this file. |
| `bnr_mort_s1_YYYYMM_manifest.yml` | Generated description of the source, selected period and Step 1 files. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_mort_s1_YYYYMM.log` | Private run log. |

The CSV and DTA contain confidential mortality information and must never enter Git.

:::

## Run Step 1

1. Open Stata.
2. Choose **User > BNR > Update CVD mortality dashboard > Step 1: Extract REDCap data**.
3. Enter the release year and month, leave replacement unticked for the first run, and select **Run extract**.
4. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do" 2026 7
   ```

5. For a deliberate rebuild of the same Step 1 data release, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do" 2026 7 replace
   ```

6. In `MORTALITY STEP 1: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: Completed successfully` and check the selected cut-off date and file locations.
7. Check that the reported record counts and death-date range are plausible. Records with valid death dates after the cut-off should be excluded; records with missing or invalid death dates remain for review.
8. Confirm the three output files and private log exist before continuing.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If Step 1 does not complete"}

Step 1 should complete routinely while the REDCap structure remains unchanged and the source data remain valid.

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| `MORTALITY STEP 1 DID NOT COMPLETE` reports an unusual or invalid source value | Correct the mortality record in REDCap, then rerun Step 1. Do not edit the generated CSV or DTA. |
| The token file is missing or empty | Correct `$BNR_MORT_REDCAP_TOKEN_FILE` or restore the authorised token file outside Git. |
| An existing data release blocks the run | Check that a rebuild is authorised, then use the complete `replace` command. |

Read the reason and log path printed in the failure summary. Do not use files from an incomplete run. For other problems, see [Troubleshoot the workflow](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).

:::
